name: ng18_10_no_tunnel_code
description: The tunnel pass never writes v, so 0xF0000004 is never set. A road (0, 10) -> (30, 10) under a hill (vertex columns 6..20 at 340 m, 300 m elsewhere): mean(6) - mean(5) = 40 > 11.2033, FindTunnelEnd from step 5 (start height 300) walks while the leading-edge mean (340) is above 300 + 13.8 and stops at step 20 (leading edge 300, lower than 340, closest to 300); length 15 > 2, |0| within tan(40 deg) x 16 x 15: steps 5 and 20 become portals (2), 6..19 interior (3). The placement then fails in the smoothing (the portals are fixed at their terrain corners, 40 m apart across one cell, more than the 11.2033 slope: 0xF0000006 at every level), never 0xF0000004. A crooked drag and flat drags never report it either.
